Leeds Firm Opens First Overseas Office

Leeds—Summit Skills Institute announced today that it will open its first office outside the United Kingdom, in Dublin, next spring. The expansion is a significant step for the company, which was founded twelve years ago to train finance teams.

The decision follows a year of unusually strong demand. “Tools change every few months, but the ability to explain a number to a room full of people does not,” said executive director Fiona Adeyemi. This vision has helped Summit win clients across a range of sectors, including insurance, logistics, and higher education.

The company puts its success down to the quality of its teaching. Léa Bertrand, a senior tutor at Summit, was recently given the National Training Award for her work on statistical literacy. Her accomplishment highlights the company’s focus on excellence as it prepares to move into a new regional market.
